Subject: Re: Redwood POC next steps — procurement constraints

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is impressed with the latency profile and the built-in batching suggestions. Procurement looked at the initial quote and flagged two issues that are blocking our internal POC signoff:

- Our legal team needs a shorter billing ramp (45 days) before a paid commit, otherwise they want a longer trial period.
- The finance lead says we need an activation credit to get engineering to prioritize integration work (they have limited runway this quarter).

Realistically, if Redwood can offer a modest set of credits to cover the first 60–90 days of token usage plus a promotional discount on year-one list pricing, we can commit to a pilot with an eye toward a 12–18 month expansion. Can you share what you can do on the credit + discount side?

Thanks —
Talia

Subject: Exec approval request — BrightForge POC combined credits + discount

Naomi / Aditya —

Looping you both in for a quick exec decision. BrightForge is ready to start a 3-month POC but procurement needs two concessions to sign: a material activation credit to cover initial dev usage and a promotional first-year discount if they convert within 45 days of the pilot end.

Why this matters: BrightForge is a multi-product mid-market account (AI ops + customer facing features). They showed +65% token growth in the demo scenarios and are open to a paid commit if we remove the onboarding blockers. With a small upfront concession we can convert to a $200k ARR opportunity inside 6–9 months (Sales forecast attached in HubSpot).

Proposed offer (sales-led, asking for exec sign-off):
- $30,000 in free credits applied over the first 90 days to offset integration + perf testing.
- 15% off list for year-one subscription if they sign within 45 days of pilot completion.
- Standard data controls and SOC 2 addendum (no additional legal deviation).

Attachments: BrightForge_POC_SOW_draft.pdf, redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-2026-1873

Timing: Procurement needs a formal approval by EOD tomorrow to keep the Q4 implementation window. Happy to adjust amounts but we need a decision quick.

Ask: Naomi — can you approve the above or propose the maximum exception you can greenlight? If you need CRO sign-off, please advise and I will escalate immediately.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and ROI case. Quoting your proposal below for context:

> Proposed offer:
> - $30,000 in free credits applied over the first 90 days
> - 15% off list for year-one if they sign within 45 days of pilot completion

A couple quick thoughts / constraints:
- I can approve up to $20k in one-off credits from the regional onramp pool without CRO approval. Anything above that needs escalation.
- For discounts, our standard promotional ceiling at this stage is 10% unless the account meets strategic-growth criteria (commit size or reference value). BrightForge looks promising, but we should lock a clause: the 15% only applies if they commit to >= $150k ARR and agree to a 12-month term.

Counterproposal I can sign off locally:
- $20,000 credits (90 days) + 10% year-one discount conditional on a $150k ARR commit within 45 days of pilot completion.

If Jordan and procurement are comfortable with the $150k commitment clause, I will sign this today. If you want to keep the $30k / 15% ask, I will escalate to CRO (Aditya) and provide a short rationale to him.
